answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, so detected correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs aggregate penalties proportional to k² rather than k. Correlation can be proven through shared keys, timing, or vote histories; slashing burns collateral and applies asymmetric depreciation, causing an exponential multiplier in capital loss as the detected sybil swarm expands. A ledge, velvet token, or meadow of accounts cannot dilute liability.
